description: This file defines the 'Profile' controller within the Opencart admin interface, handling user profile display and update functionalities. It manages rendering the user profile page, fetching user data, handling profile save requests, validation, and permissions.

classes.name: Profile
classes.description: Controller class responsible for displaying and updating the user profile page within the Opencart admin system.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the user profile page with user info, breadcrumbs, and associated views.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update the user profile, including validation and permission checks.
